$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support; ignored by Force Org

terms.description: the game's own words for built-in concepts, in expressions and the UI

grants.description: contingent resources a filled slot of this role grants its contingent, e.g. `{ "reserve": 1, "elite": 1 }`; a slot with several roles grants as the first that grants anything

additionalProperties.description: A unit type; `description` holds the rules every unit of the type follows

subTypes.description: unit sub-types (validator 1.12.0); when set, unit and profile `tags`, `tag:` references and profile filter values that match no sub-type (or unit type) are warnings

traits.description: unit traits (validator 2.0.0); when set, unit and profile `traits`, the traits effects give or take, selector `traits` and `trait:` references that match no trait here are warnings

optionLabel.description: what the slot options offered on slots with this tag are called, e.g. "Special Option"; left out, "Option"

color.description: the tag's colour in the app's palette (`amber`, `red`, `orange`, `green`, `teal`, `blue`, `violet`, `pink`, `slate`); left out or unknown, the app picks one from the tag's id

icon.description: the tag's mark in the app's icon set (`star`, `spark`, `diamond`, `hex`, `cross`, `flag`, `swords`, `crown`, `fleur`, `circle`, `triangle`, `square`, `target`, `bolt`); left out or unknown, the app picks one from the tag's id

scope.description: `list`: spent across the list against a limit the player sets (points, credits). `unit`: spent within one unit against a capacity from its profile (equipment slots). `contingent`: granted and spent within each contingent, never set by the player (reserve points); going below zero is a list issue

message.description: contingent resources: the issue shown when a contingent has spent too much

usedFor.description: what amounts in this resource may be given for; left out, by scope: `list` → unit, additional model, option, slot option and group costs; `unit` → option and slot option costs; `contingent` → group costs and grants

defaultLimit.description: list resources: the limit offered for new lists

capacityStat.description: unit resources: the profile stat holding the unit's capacity

choices.description: list-level choices, e.g. stance or battle size

listRules.description: typed list-wide rules, e.g. percentage caps

groups.description: groups every faction may take (core formations shared by every faction)

specialRules.description: special rules that belong to no single faction

slotOptions.description: choices slots with a tag offer (e.g. benefits for tagged slots)

subChoices.description: sub-choices options in every faction may offer

__schema3.description: A record id: lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `infantry-squad` (letters a-z and digits, with single hyphens between words)

word.description: For built-in scopes (and `group` as a reference kind): the word data authors may write in expressions instead of the built-in name, e.g. `formation` for `group`

__schema7.description: A plain number, or an expression that evaluates to one

__schema9.description: An expression in the Force Org expression language (docs/specs/expression_language_spec_2026-10-17.md)

additionalProperties.description: A unit sub-type, given to units and profiles as a `tags` entry matching its name (case-insensitively) or id; `description` holds the rules every model with the sub-type follows
A unit trait, given to units and profiles as a `traits` entry matching its name (case-insensitively) or id; `description` holds what the trait means

contingent.description: `root` groups start a contingent; linked groups attach to a root group of one of the listed types and share its faction source

source.description: root groups only: `main` uses the list's main faction and sub-faction, `ally` a different one the player picks, `any` (validator 2.1.0) any faction of the game the player picks, the main one included. Only a `main` root starts the main contingent. Left out = `main`

min.description: how many of this type a list may hold (at least)

max.description: how many of this type a list may hold (at most)

cost.description: what a group of this type costs, counted in its contingent for contingent resources and in the list for list resources, e.g. `{ "reserve": 1, "elite": 1 }`; a group's own `cost` replaces it

__schema16.description: A whole number (0 or more), or an expression that evaluates to a number

items.description: Where an amount in a resource can be given: a unit's cost, the cost of each additional model, an option's cost (with its sub-choice values), a slot option's cost, a group's cost, or what a role or special rule grants

numeric.description: numeric stats can be shifted by stat effects ('3+' -1 → '2+')

additionalProperties.description: A list-level choice, e.g. stance or battle size
One of a list choice's values

__schema27.description: the units `effects` apply to, seen with their own traits and sub-faction modifiers (validator 1.13.0); left out = every unit in the list, allies included

anyOf.description: A named selector by id, accepted wherever a `UnitSelector` is, e.g. `"@line-infantry"`

__schema29.description: Picks units by id, role, trait and profile type/tags; left out, a field matches every unit

__schema32.description: a unit matches when it has any of these traits, matched as case-insensitive text

__schema34.description: a unit matches when one of its profiles does (or the unit itself, if it has no profiles)

__schema35.description: Picks profiles by their type and tags (the unit's included), matched as case-insensitive text. Left out, every profile is picked.

__schema38.description: (validator 2.5.0) special rule ids: a unit matches when it or one of its profiles holds any of them, with any value

__schema40.description: a unit that matches any of these does not match the selector

items.description: Units to leave out, matched like a selector (its fields all apply); e.g. `{ "profiles": { "anyOf": ["Unique"] } }` leaves out every unit with a Unique profile

__schema42.description: stat, special-rule, trait and slot-tag effects on every matching unit in the list while this value is picked (validator 1.13.0), e.g. a stance value giving every unit a trait

items.description: applied to every matching unit in the list while the value is picked, right after the unit's own traits and sub-faction modifiers; the pick is already the condition, so a `when` needs no `choice()`

__schema44.description: several stat changes sharing one profile filter

items.description: `add` shifts the number and keeps its suffix: '3+' -1 → '2+', '6"' +1 → '7"'

__schema51.description: A rule's condition plus the player-facing reason shown when it isn't met

__schema53.description: changes the special rules of the profiles `profiles` picks (all of them when left out) and the unit's own: `remove`, then `replace`, then `rule` (added). Needs at least one of the three

__schema56.description: the rule each picked profile gains

__schema58.description: (validator 2.5.0) rule ids each picked profile loses, whatever their value

__schema60.description: (validator 2.5.0) each picked profile loses any of `from` (whatever their value) and, only if it held one, gains `to`, e.g. `{ "from": ["skirmisher"], "to": { "id": "armoured", "value": "1" } }`

__schema63.description: changes the unit's traits (traits belong to the whole unit, so there is no profile filter); traits match as case-insensitive text

__schema67.description: traits the unit loses, if it has them

__schema69.description: the unit loses any of `from` and, only if it had one, gains `to`

__schema72.description: (validator 2.2.0) the slot that holds the unit counts as having these slot tags, so it offers their slot options and `slot.is(tag:…)` reads true. It tags the slot, not the unit, so there is no profile filter; in place before slot options are offered. Not allowed in a slot option's `effects`

__schema74.description: game-declared slot tags the slot holding the unit counts as having, e.g. `["prime"]`

__schema75.description: for the tags it adds, only slot options of these `category`s are offered, e.g. `["honour"]`; left out, every option of the tag. Combined with the slot's own `tagOptions` and other slotTag effects on the same tag, only options every restriction allows are offered

oneOf.description: Caps what may be spent on matching units, e.g. heavy units 25%, allies 50%
Limits how many matching units (or groups) a scope may hold
Escape hatch for list rules no typed form covers. A rule only flags the list; it never prevents anything

__schema81.description: count only these units; left out = every unit

__schema82.description: count only units in contingents whose root group is one of these types

__schema94.description: `list` (default): the condition is checked once for the whole list. `group`: checked once for each group (of the listed `groupTypes`, or any) with `group`, `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list` available; the message is reported for each group that fails

__schema96.description: with `scope: "group"`: only groups of these types

type.description: a group type id from the game

roles.description: units of any of these roles may fill the slot

required.description: must be filled for the list to be valid (compulsory slots)

repeat.description: the slot may be added more than once, each copy holding one unit (a team's vehicles, optional slots); `max` left out = no limit

units.description: only matching units may fill this slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units

tagOptions.description: (validator 2.2.0) tag id → which of that tag's slot options this slot offers, e.g. `{ "prime": { "categories": ["honour"] } }`; each key must be one of the slot's `tags`. A tag left out offers every option

unitWhen.description: (validator 2.6.0) a condition on the unit filling the slot, checked against it as configured (its options' gear and traits included, before the group's effects) and shown as an issue while false; units are still offered by role and `units`, though an app may hide units that none of their options could make meet it. E.g. a slot of two roles that units of the second may fill only with some gear: `{ "if": "unit.is(role:officer) or unit.has(equipment:signal-array)", "message": "…" }`

units.description: only matching units may fill any slot, including slots a mechanic adds, except slots with a `source`

requirementText.description: shown when a requirement isn't met

min.description: how many of this group a list must hold, e.g. a mandatory veteran formation

max.description: how many of this group a list may hold

effects.description: applied to every unit in the group, e.g. "Every unit in this group gains the Gun Line trait"

addedSlotRoles.description: (validator 2.6.0) the only roles the `slot` effects of slot options picked in this group's slots may add: each effect's `roleChoices` is narrowed to them, and an option left with none isn't offered. `[]` = no option that adds a slot; left out, no limit

listEffects.description: (validator 2.7.0) while the group is in the list, each entry's `effects` apply to the matching units in reach, wherever they are, e.g. `[{ "units": "@vehicles", "effects": [{ "kind": "specialRule", "rule": { "id": "fearless" } }] }]`

additionalProperties.description: Limits the slot options a slot offers for one of its tags (validator 2.2.0). Where several restrictions apply to one tag on one slot (this and slotTag effects' `categories`), only options every one of them allows are offered

__schema103.description: only slot options with one of these `category`s are offered for the tag

__schema104.description: Where a slot's units come from instead of the contingent. Units keep their own records (gear, rules, upgrades) but not their home sub-faction's unit modifiers. The slot's `units` selector picks among them, seeing only each unit's own traits; the group's `units` doesn't apply

__schema105.description: a faction of the same game, possibly from another source; may be the contingent's own

__schema106.description: units of these sub-factions of `faction` may fill the slot too (`any` = every one loaded), whether or not the contingent took them; left out, only the faction's own units

__schema108.description: applied to the unit filling the slot, after the group's effects, e.g. replacing a borrowed unit's faction trait

items.description: units the list must already hold before the group can be taken

__schema112.description: where they're counted: the group's contingent outside it (default) or its root group

items.description: applied to every unit in the group, including units in slots added later
(validator 2.7.0) Effects a group gives units outside it, e.g. "every Walker in a list with this group gains Fearless"

__schema118.description: the units `effects` apply to, seen with their own traits and sub-faction modifiers; left out = every unit in reach

__schema119.description: which units are in reach: `list` (the default) = every unit in the list, in every contingent, allies included; `contingent` = the units in the group's contingent

__schema121.description: stat, special-rule, trait and slot-tag effects

__schema122.description: applied to every matching unit in reach while the group is in the list, right after list choice values; an effect's `when` sees the unit's own slot and group, not this group's

configurable.description: the rule takes a value, e.g. Ambush (X)

defaultValue.description: the value a configurable rule has when a selection gives none

grants.description: contingent resources a unit with the rule grants its contingent (negative takes some away). Expressions may use the `rule` scope, e.g. Quartermaster (X) `{ "reserve": "rule.value() - 1" }`

slots.description: slots each unit with the rule adds to its group, e.g. one filled from another faction

items.description: A slot a mechanic adds to a group

__schema127.description: the slot's role; with several the player picks one

__schema128.description: only matching units may fill the slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units

additionalProperties.description: A selector with a name, referenced as `@id` from expressions and selector fields
A choice made for a slot with the option's tag, applying its effects to the unit in the slot (and the group), e.g. special benefits or enhancements. One option per tag per slot.

__schema134.description: offered on slots with this tag

__schema135.description: (validator 2.2.0) what kind of option this is among its tag's, e.g. `honour`; a slot's `tagOptions` and a slotTag effect's `categories` offer only options of the categories they name

__schema136.description: only offered on slots of these roles; left out = any role

__schema138.description: only offered on slots whose unit matches, seen as it stands before slot-option effects (its traits from option and group effects included), e.g. `{ "traits": ["Field Army"] }` for an option only Field Army units may take; left out = any unit

__schema139.description: added to the cost of the unit in the slot

oneOf.description: adds a slot (or `count` slots) to the group; with several roles the player picks one
units of these roles may also fill the slot

__schema142.description: how many such slots the option adds to the group (default 1), each holding its own unit (validator 2.4.0); with several `roleChoices` the player picks one role, which all of them take, e.g. `{ "kind": "slot", "roleChoices": ["support"], "count": 3 }`

__schema145.description: (validator 2.6.0) only offered while true, seeing the unit as its `units` does; a pick whose `when` turns false is an issue. E.g. `{ "if": "group.is(group:gun-line)", "message": "Only in a Gun Line" }`

additionalProperties.description: A choice made alongside an option, defined once and shared by every option that offers it

costMultiplier.description: resource id → multiplier for the option's cost, e.g. a turret mount `{ "points": 3 }`
